info.title: Payment Credit Advice Push Notification
info.description: Notifies when a U.S. or Brazil real-time payment is received.

tags.name: Push Notification for Payments v2 APIs

post.summary: Notifies when a U.S. real-time payment is received

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: Identifying the content of the payload as JSON. </br> ex. application/json

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: A unique access token to be used for a single request .</br> ex. Bearer XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: User id which will be provided at the time of onboarding </br> Eg. 123898733525554444

parameters.name: userAuthKey
parameters.description: This will contain the encrypted password; which will be used to authenticate user

requestBody.description: Payload that will  be sent to client

settlementDate.description: Date on which payment is  settled in YYYY-MM-DD format

creditAmount.description: The amount that was credited into the account. The currency of the amount is the currency of the account. Note: The decimal separator is a dot.

initiatingParty.description: Party who is sending the payment

debtor.description: Party that owes the debt or is making the payment on behalf of an ultimate debtor

debtorAgent.description: The Financial Institution holding the debit account

ultimateDebtor.description: Party on whose behalf the payment is being made

creditor.description: Party to which the payment will be made

ultimateCreditor.description: Party to which the debt is owed in a "Receive on Behalf of" scenario.

creditorAgent.description: The Financial Institution holding the credit account

chargesBearer.description: Specifies which party/parties will bear the charges associated with the processing of the payment transaction Enum:  "DEBT", "CRED", "SHAR", "SLEV"

relatedRemittance.description: Provides information related to the handling of the remittance information by any of the agents in the transaction processing chain.

unstructuredRemittance.description: Unstructured information to be conveyed to the receiver. Length : 1 - 140

instructionIdentification.description: Unique identification as assigned by an instructing party for an instructed party to unambiguously identify the instruction. Length : 1 - 35

endToEndIdentification.description: Unique identification assigned by the initiating party to unumbiguously identify the transaction. This identification is passed on, unchanged, throughout the entire end-to-end chain.  Length : 1 - 35

clearingSystemReference.description: Unique identification assigned by the initiating party to unumbiguously identify the transaction. This identification is passed on, unchanged, throughout the entire end-to-end chain.  Length : 1 - 35

priority.description: Indicator of the urgency or order of importance that the instructing party would like the instructed party to apply to the processing of the instruction. : 1 - 4

serviceLevel.description: Agreement under which or rules under which the transaction should be processed. : Length: 1 - 35

categoryOfPurpose.description: Specifies the high level purpose of the instruction based on a set of pre-defined categories. Usage: This is used by the initiating party to provide information concerning the processing of the payment. It is likely to trigger special processing by any of the agents involved in the payment chain Length: 1 - 35

type.description: Enumeration indicating whether the party is an organization or a private individual. "enum": "ORG","IND"

identifiers.description: An alpha numeric value that can uniquely identify a party within the specified issuer. Length : 1 - 35

dateOfBirth.description: Date of Birth of an Individual. : Length: 1 - 35

countrySubDivisionOfBirth.description: State, Province or County of Birth of an Individual. Length : 1 - 35

cityOfBirth.description: City of Birth of an Individual. Length: 1 - 35

countryOfBirth.description: Country of Birth of an Individual. Length: 2

countryOfResidence.description: The country in which the party resides. Length: 2

name.description: The name of the Financial Institution. Length : 1 - 35

identification.description: An alpha numeric value that can uniquely identify the Financial Institution based on a specific Scheme. Length: 1 - 35

schemeName.description: AIdentification scheme within which the identifier is unique enum: "BIC", "UKSORT", "USABA"

name.description: An alpha numeric value that can uniquely identify the Financial Institution based on a specific Scheme. Length: 1 - 140

structuredRemittance.description: Information supplied to enable the matching/reconciliation of an entry with the items that the payment is intended to settle, such as commercial invoices in an accounts' receivable system, in a structured form.

type.description: The type of the remittance document. Length : 1 - 35

number.description: Unique and unambiguous identification of the referred document. Length : 1 - 35

date.description: Date associated with the referred document. Length 1 - 35

addressLine.description: Address of the party Length : 1 - 70 Min: 1 Max: 2

city.description: Identifies a subdivision of a country, for instance state, region, or province : 1 - 35

country.description: ISO country code of the party Length : 2

postalCode.description: Zip code or postal code Length : 16

Name.description: Name of the account, as assigned by the account servicing institution, in agreement with the account owner in order to provide an additional means of identification of the account. Length : 1 - 70

identification.description: Account identification. Per RFC3696 the max length of an email alias for an account is 256. Length : 1 - 256

type.description: Identifies the type of the account, such as Deposit, Savings, Digital Wallet, etc.
